anchor: With a ninth-level magic slot, can I command six flesh-eating corpses at once, or only a couple of mummified ones?
Could an eighth-level magic slot let me command five corpse-eaters, or instead only two of the tougher grave-dwelling types?
Which one-use item, thrown into the air, leaves creatures that fail a 15 toughness roll unable to act and gasping for breath, but spares oozes and plants?
Which magic item looks like a vanishing substance but actually sets off helpless hacking fits, and which restorative spell ends it?
What extra training do bards on a storytelling path get at level three, and how many skills can I choose for it?
As a sneaky adventurer hitting level seven, if I roll nine or less on a check for something I'm trained in, can I count it as ten?
Does a sneaky character's dice bump at level seven apply to sword swings, or only to checks involving things I'm trained at?
If I uncork a painted brass vessel on my turn and smoke pours out, what fiery being emerges?
After a brass vessel is unstoppered, how soon does the smoke vanish in harmless flame, and how far can the creature appear from me?
Which huge evil brute ignores chilling effects, swings an axe that deals icy damage, and can shout to grant an ally temporary hit points?
What massive monster fires long-range arrows that deal chilling harm and slow the target by 10 feet until its next turn?
Once I hit level thirteen as a martial artist, does my blocking skill work against any harm type, or only against physical blows?
Which musical reed instrument lets me summon vermin swarms when I play it, with a few charges that refill at dawn?
If I play a melodic wind instrument, can I win over a wild, pest-filled swarm and make it obey my orders while I keep playing?
If a spell cuts my ground pace from 30 to 15 feet, how far can I move on my turn if I hurry?
Can I use my flying or swimming rate instead of walking when I hurry across the battlefield, and pick a different one each time?
Which wrist guards add two points to my protection rating only when I wear no body covering and carry no buckler?
Is there a rare pair of wrist guards that needs me to bond with it before its protection bonus works?
Which tiny flying creature can copy simple sounds like a murmur, and can I tell the imitation apart with a DC 10 perceptiveness check?
My party is being pecked at by a bird with only 2 hit points that flies 50 feet per turn; what creature is it?
If I roll a 55 on a percentile table of small charms, what miniature item do I get, and is it rare?
Which percentile roll range on a table of tiny charms produces a whip-shaped one, and how rare is it?
Among five escalating outdoor conditions, which one comes after a strong breeze and is the step before a tempest?
When I shift the sky in stages from still air upward, what is the first level with noticeable wind?
Which big sea-dwelling creature gets a better chance to bite wounded targets, and can only breathe underwater?
Does a large marine predator sense nearby things without eyes out to 60 feet, while moving much faster in water than on land?
If I shatter a green jewel, what watery spirit appears to serve me, and when does it vanish?
When I crush a yellow stone on my turn, what earth creature comes forth, and does it act before or after me in initiative?
On a d100 roll of 93 to 97 from a random-effect stick, what form does the closest creature take if the d4 shows 3 or 4?
Which random-effect stick outcome could shift the nearest creature into a dark-furred forest animal, and what die roll is needed?
Which druid or ranger spell makes a 20-foot circle of ground sprout barbs that hurt anyone who walks through, 2d4 for each 5 feet?
If a field of barbs is disguised as natural ground, what check lets an unseeing creature detect hazards before stepping in?
Which protective item can hover to guard me for a minute, leaving my hands free, after spending a quick extra move on my turn?
When my hovering guard drops because I'm unable to act or die, does it hit the ground or land in my hand?
If I'm rendered unable to hear at all, what happens to checks that depend on listening?
Which large brute regrows 15 hit points each turn but loses that healing for a turn if hit by acid or fire?
When a big brute ends its turn badly hurt after taking 15 cutting damage, does a limb fall off, and does a missing one cause fatigue?
Which small vermin can climb as fast as it walks and gains a better shot at hitting when a buddy stands within 5 feet of the target?
What little pest has 7 hit points and sees in darkness up to 60 feet?
Which ninth-level death-magic spell lets up to nine willing friends leave their sleeping bodies to wander another plane, linked by a silvery cord?
Can harm dealt to a sleeping traveler's body hurt its wandering form, and what happens if its silver cord is severed?
Which spellcaster can vanish from sight without leaving tracks and conjure floating glimmers at will?
Which monster can alter its appearance for a full day and fire a sickening beam at third-level power?
What spell halves a foe's movement, costs them two points of defense and nimbleness, and limits them to one attack when they take the attack action?
For a creature hit by a time-warping effect, what are the odds its gesture-based spells fizzle, and how can it end that effect?
What sneaky trap can I carve onto a table or chest that goes off only for certain creatures or when someone speaks a password?
What happens to a secret enchanted mark if someone hauls the table it's on more than ten feet away?
Which humanoid makes two attacks with a short blade or longbow, has a plus-six bonus to sneaking, and speaks Common plus one more tongue?
With about 16 hit points and armor rating 13, which medium-sized wanderer has strong woodcraft and wilderness know-how?
Which bubble-shaped effect with a 20-foot radius makes sound impossible inside and stops spellcasters who need speech?
Could creatures inside a noise-free bubble be unable to hear anything, and how far away can I place its center?
Which nature-focused caster keys its power to the wise-minded ability and chooses two skills from eight options?
What class gets light armor and shields, simple weapons, and a plant-remedy toolkit with eight-sided hit dice?
Once I reach level two as a martial artist, how do I get extra running pace when I'm not in protective gear or holding a shield?
As a martial artist gains more levels, does the extra running pace from being unprotected ever increase?
What enchantment makes a foe fall flat and be unable to act, then giggle helplessly for a minute unless it passes a mental save?
If a foe affected by a mind-based effect that makes it giggle takes harm, does it get an edge on its next save?
Which magic weapon can instantly slay a foe under 100 hit points on a natural 20 unless it passes a DC 15 toughness roll?
Does a magic blade that has spent all its charges still keep its soul-taking trick?
What large work animal has only 15 hit points and strikes with its hooves for crushing harm?
Which pack animal moves about 40 feet per turn and has an armor rating of 10 with almost no intelligence?
Which creature senses metal within 30 feet and gnaws away the defensive value of a nonmagical breastplate?
What creature instinctively lashes out with feelers when a blow connects, and can its feelers ruin my metal armor?
Which scepter-like legendary item can heal for one charge or bring someone back from death for five charges?
If I use up a legendary item's last charge, what's the chance it vanishes in a harmless flash of light?
Which sneaky archetype suits an adventurer who delves into old ruins and wants maximum benefit from magic loot?
Which eighth-level mind blast deals 10d12 mental damage and stops its target from casting spells unless it passes an intellect save?
Which high-tier restorative or wish-granting magic can remove a lingering mind-scrambling effect, and does the victim get another try every month?
Which shape-changing neutral good creature bites humanoids to curse them, so a cursed humanoid who drops to zero hit points rises as one of its kind?
If I'm a humanoid facing a shape-changer's bite, what toughness roll must I beat at DC 14, and how long am I protected after passing?
Which arena fighter makes three thrusts per turn and can drop a Medium or smaller foe to the dirt with a buckler strike?
If a melee blow lands on a warrior holding a weapon, can it raise its guard to dodge the hit?
If I'm pinned down so I can't move at all, do foes get a better shot at me, and do my swings suffer?
If I'm immobilized in place, do my nimble-reflex rolls against incoming hazards get harder, and can any effect raise my movement rate?
At level eighteen as a champion warrior, what boosts my odds on death rolls, and what happens when I roll 18 to 20?
When I'm at half my hit points or fewer with at least 1 hit point left, how much do I regain at the start of each turn?
